result.title: Finite Spectral Depth Controls Gaussian Entrance Rank and Avoidance of the First Gradient-Flow Saddle
result.summary: Matrix factorization provides a simple model for studying the training dynamics of neural networks. Recent studies of gradient flow under small initialization have analyzed how trajectories escape from a neighborhood of the origin and approach their first nonzero stationary point. In this paper, we study continuous-time dynamics that applies a finite number of Newton-Schulz iterations to the normalized matrix gradient (Muon). We show that the number of Newton-Schulz steps can change the rank selected during the early stages of training and allow the resulting trajectory to bypass the first nonzero stationary point approached by gradient flow. Under an additional residual-inertia condition, we prove that bypass occurs for all sufficiently large finite Newton-Schulz depths and provide an explicit sufficient threshold. We also construct an example in which the bypass threshold is four.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在矩阵分解的连续时间训练动力学中分析 Muon 式更新：对归一化梯度施加有限步 Newton-Schulz 迭代，证明迭代深度会改变早期训练选中的秩，并使轨迹绕过梯度流首先到达的非零驻点，还给出残差惯性条件下普遍绕过的显式阈值（示例阈值为 4）。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「迭代深度控制有效秩与驻点选择」的结论可能为 latent 推理状态的秩坍塌、低秩表示容量及训练期隐状态动力学提供分析视角，但联系属概念类比，需核查可否迁移到 VLM 内部状态。
